QF.id: Cat III AIF Fees and Performance_7

question.text: For close-ended Category III AIFs, incentive fees are best payable:

answer.text: After completion of the stated fund tenure
On every exit from an investee company

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Section 6.1.2, incentive fees should be paid at end of tenure to avoid double-counting of gains in years that later reverse. The Trap: Yearly payments expose investors to 'clawback risk' if subsequent years reverse profits. Cross-Exam Context: Similar logic appears in PE/VC waterfall structures (XIX-A). Distributor's Pro-Tip: Even if PPM permits yearly incentive, advise investors to prefer end-of-tenure crystallisation.
